The magic runs from November 14 (Balloon-Twisting Santa) through December 20 (Winter Magic at The Outlet Shoppes of the Bluegrass), with Sunday's Sparkle with Santa and Mrs. Claus, Light Up Simpsonville (December 5), the Shelby County Christmas Parade (December 5) and Christmas on Main in Taylorsville (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
